spots.name: Underbridge Mario
spots.blurb: You've reached Underbridge Mario, a graffiti piece. The artwork is located on the west, central column of the bridge, and is visible from the south bank of the river.  Take Trail A to view it.

spots.name: Ray of Sunshine
spots.blurb: You've reached Ray of Sunshine, a mural. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
